name: TX Group AG
summary: TX Group AG operates a network of platforms and participations that provides users with information, orientation, entertainment, and other services in Switzerland. It operates through five segments: TX Markets, Goldbach, 20 Minuten, Tamedia, and Group & Ventures. The company operates platforms in the areas of real estate, automotive, marketplaces, and finance and insurance services, as well as operates JobCloud, a job portal. It also provides advertising marketing in the areas of TV, OOH, radio, online, mobile and performance marketing. In addition, the company offers daily newspapers, magazines, and publishing services.
